# LWS - Linux Web Services

> {{ site.description | strip_newlines | strip }}

LWS is a command-line tool for Proxmox VE administrators: creating, scaling,
snapshotting, backing up and migrating LXC containers, managing Proxmox hosts
and firewall security groups, and deploying Docker workloads inside containers.
It is a single Python entrypoint (`lws.py`, built with Click) plus an optional
Flask REST API (`api.py`) that runs the CLI, with Swagger documentation and a
minimal web UI. Current release: {{ site.lws_version }}.

The full text of every page below is in [llms-full.txt]({{ '/llms-full.txt' | absolute_url }}).
